shots.content: Inside a meeting room, a rectangular conference table stands between a presentation screen and a glass door, with windows along one side; a clear walkway runs opposite the window. A man in an orange shirt sits in the door-side window seat and proposes taking a holiday to rest from overwork. A woman in a white shirt sits in the screen-side window seat, and a man in a blue shirt sits in the screen-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the glass door end, looking along the conference table toward the presentation screen, with both window-side seats and the screen-end seat and the presentation screen in frame.

shots.content: A man in an orange shirt and a woman in a white shirt exchange seats; she suggests taking a countryside retreat, but he calls the countryside dull.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the walkway side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A woman in a white shirt proposes taking a sea voyage instead.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the walkway side, centered on the person at the door-side window seat.

shots.content: A man in an orange shirt objects to a sea voyage because of travel discomfort.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the conference table.
